title: Boss: The Calendar Crash
story: The village birthday board shows wrong ages on exactly the days around a birthday. Find the logic bug.
goal: Fix age_in_years(born, today): the age goes up only on or after the birthday.
starter:
from datetime import date


def age_in_years(born, today):
    b = date.fromisoformat(born)
    t = date.fromisoformat(today)
    years = t.year - b.year
    if (t.month, t.day) > (b.month, b.day):
        years -= 1
    return years
hints: Test three dates by hand: before, on and after the birthday. When should years be reduced by one?
You subtract one only if the birthday has NOT happened yet this year.

solution:
from datetime import date


def age_in_years(born, today):
    b = date.fromisoformat(born)
    t = date.fromisoformat(today)
    years = t.year - b.year
    if (t.month, t.day) < (b.month, b.day):
        years -= 1
    return years
